tagline: Through farmland and The Plains to horse country.
intro: Old Tavern Road leaves US 17 at the hamlet of Old Tavern and heads northeast through farmland, crossing Piney Branch of Broad Run and meeting Interstate 66 before it comes into The Plains. It is a little over three miles long. From there Halfway Road, once part of US 15, carries on to Middleburg.
A third road belongs to the same byway. Springs Road angles up from near Jeffersonton into Warrenton.

moments.title: The Plains
moments.text: The maps called it White Plains through the Civil War, when Mosby's Raiders worked the area, though its post office had gone by The Plains since 1831.

moments.title: Middleburg
moments.text: Leven Powell founded the town in 1787 and declined to have it named for him, and since the early 1900s foxhunting and steeplechasing have made it the Nation's Horse and Hunt Capital.
